ANGELS OF MASTEMAH — COMPLETE TEXT

FRAGMENT 1 — THE FIRST PERIOD AND MASTEMAH'S RULE — 4Q390 Fragment 1

1 [YHWH spoke saying:] And I will give them into the hand of the angels of Mastemah and they will rule over them. And I will hide My face from Yisra'el and they will be given into the hand of their enemies. And they will do evil in all my land.

2 For they have abandoned My covenant and My Torah and they have followed the desires of their hearts and the counsel of the nations around them. Therefore I will remove My protection from them for seventy years.

3 In that period the angels of Mastemah will go out against the children of Yisra'el and will deceive them. They will speak falsehood in the name of YHWH and they will lead the people from the true paths into the paths of destruction.

4 And the priests will not separate the holy from the profane. They will mix the sacred offerings with unclean things. They will take payment for their judgments and they will teach falsehood as Torah and Torah as optional.

5 And in the second period of seventy years the wickedness will be greater than in the first. For each generation that falls further from YHWH becomes more hardened in its falling. The mercy of YHWH is great but the stubbornness of the heart of flesh is also great.

6 But YHWH will not abandon His people forever. At the end of the appointed periods He will remember His covenant with the first fathers. He will send a spirit of understanding among them and they will return. And He will restore them.

COMPARATIVE MANUSCRIPT NOTES

[DSS] 4Q390 is a pseudepigraphic text — written in the voice of YHWH speaking about the people of Yisra'el in the third person while addressing a prophetic figure. The seventy-year period structure parallels Yirmeyahu's prophecy of seventy years of exile and its reinterpretation in Daniyel 9. This confirms that the periodization of history in seventy-year units was an established Qumran hermeneutical framework.

[ORIT GE'EZ] The Orit Ge'ez prophetic tradition in Chanokh 89-90 — the Animal Apocalypse — presents Israelite history as a sequence of periods governed alternately by angelic guardians and by foreign oppressors. The Angels of Mastemah text operates within the same theological framework: historical periods are governed by specific spiritual powers operating under YHWH's ultimate authority.

[MASORETIC VARIANT] The Masoretic prophetic corpus — particularly Yirmeyahu and Yehezkel — describes the exile as YHWH hiding His face from Yisra'el due to covenant unfaithfulness. The Angels of Mastemah text develops this into a systematic theology of historical periods: the exile is not merely YHWH's withdrawal but YHWH's deliberate appointment of Mastemah's angels as temporary governors of the wayward people.

[CRITICAL NOTE] The accusation that the priests "take payment for their judgments and teach falsehood as Torah" is a direct polemic against the Jerusalem priestly establishment. This confirms the antagonistic relationship between the Qumran community and the Temple priesthood. The angels of Mastemah ruling over Yisra'el is not an abstract theological statement — it is the Qumran community's theological explanation for the corruption they observed in the official religious institutions of their time.
